title: Rewind 1999
blurb: Dial-up screeches, burnt CDs and a Tamagotchi that did not make it. Born-in-the-90s edition.

prompts: Most likely to still own a CD burned with the wrong songs on it
Most likely to cry about a Tamagotchi that they forgot to feed
Most likely to know the entire dial-up modem sound by heart
Most likely to blame the old family PC for crashing during a game of Solitaire
Most likely to keep every Beanie Baby in a plastic case "for the investment"
Most likely to still remember their first email address and be embarrassed about it
Most likely to rewind a VHS tape before returning it, as a matter of principle
Most likely to have a flip phone ringtone they still miss
Most likely to tell everyone that Saturday morning cartoons were better
Most likely to call a friend on the landline and ask for their mum first
Most likely to spend three weeks arranging the perfect MSN screen name
Most likely to pass a note in class folded into a tiny paper triangle
Most likely to get hooked on a game from a free CD-ROM that came with a magazine
Most likely to still hum the theme of a childhood TV show
Most likely to trade stickers in the playground like it was a stock market
Most likely to learn to type by playing a dinosaur typing game
Most likely to make a mixtape from the radio and talk over the start of the song
Most likely to beg for a pair of platform sneakers at age ten
Most likely to have a pet rock with a name, a bed and a favourite place
Most likely to queue for hours to buy the newest handheld console
Most likely to get excited about a new gel pen set
Most likely to leave a message on someone's answering machine and then beg them to delete it
Most likely to bring a disposable camera to every event and never develop the film
Most likely to play a snake game on a phone for hours
Most likely to rock frosted tips and a puka shell necklace with total confidence
Most likely to write the lyrics to a song down while listening to it on a tape
Most likely to remember the first time they used a search engine
Most likely to call the radio station to request a song and hold for twenty minutes
Most likely to spend all their pocket money at the corner shop on mixed lollies
Most likely to use a bulky camcorder to film a home movie with terrible special effects
Most likely to rush home to watch a favourite show and miss the first two minutes
Most likely to dress up as a pop star for a school talent quest
Most likely to have a poster of their favourite band covering the whole bedroom wall
Most likely to yell "pause" in a video game as if the other player would listen
Most likely to spend recess playing marbles for keepsies
Most likely to get their first mobile at sixteen and only text three people
Most likely to beg to stay up late for the season finale
Most likely to call a friend by landline and sit in silence for an hour
Most likely to keep a friendship bracelet until it falls apart
Most likely to wait a full week for the new episode of a favourite show
Most likely to blow in a cartridge and swear it fixed the game
